title.en: An Act Establishing the Salihid National High School in Barangay Salihid, Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Establishing the Salihid National High School in Barangay Salihid, Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Salihid Quốc gia tại Barangay Salihid, Đô thị Barotac Nuevo, Tỉnh Iloilo, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này, và cho các mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Salihid แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Salihid เทศบาล Barotac Nuevo จังหวัด Iloilo และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้ และเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Salihid Nasional di Barangay Salihid, Kotamadya Barotac Nuevo, Provinsi Iloilo, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Salihid Kebangsaan di Barangay Salihid, Perbandaran Barotac Nuevo, Wilayah Iloilo, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8889_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay Salihid, Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo, to be known as the Salihid National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
